text:
Standing there on the pitch...in the stadium...
in front of everyone!\c
There’s really no words for it, but...
I can barely contain myself! My heart’s racing![VAR 0114(0005)]
You’ve made it at last, Hop.\nAnd you, too, [VAR 0100(0000)]![VAR 0114(0004)]

So you’re the two Trainers our Champion
endorsed himself!\c
Welcome, and it’s a delight to meet you!
I’m Rose, of course.[VAR 0114(0006)]

Oh, and what’s this?! I see you both already
possess Dynamax Bands!\c
How wonderful! It seems you two have been led
here by the guiding light of the Wishing Stars.\c
By the way, it was my wonderful company that
invented those Dynamax Bands, you know![VAR 0114(0006)]

I daresay this year’s Gym Challenge is looking
to be an absolute blast!\c
Very good—very good indeed! That means the
whole Galar region is in for some excitement![VAR 0114(0006)]

The Gym Challenge is an excellent opportunity
to show off your Dynamax Pokémon!\c
Now, I’m terribly sorry, but there is some urgent
business I need to attend to, so I must be on
my way.\c
The best of luck to both of you![VAR 0114(0006)]

The chairman certainly seems to be in
high spirits!\c
Now, listen closely, you two. You’ve both only
just started on your path as Trainers.\c
If you want to win, you need to do more than
just train your Pokémon. You need to train
yourselves, too.[VAR 0114(0004)]

Let’s do it, [VAR 0100(0000)]!
You know the Gym Challenge has a set order that
you’ve gotta visit the Gyms in, right?\c
The first is in Turffield!
And to get there, we need to head to Route 3![VAR 0114(0005)]
